title: Tracking-URI detectors check URI shape only, not partition, region, or account
answers: is SageMaker tracking server ARN detected correctly
does the tracking URI check accept GovCloud or China ARNs
why does the SageMaker ARN check not validate the region
sagemaker endpoint ARN mistaken for a tracking server
body:
Convention: is_sagemaker_mlflow_tracking_uri in mlflow/utils/uri.py checks only the ARN prefix, the sagemaker service, the exact mlflow-tracking-server resource type, and a nonempty resource id.
It does not allowlist AWS partitions (aws, aws-cn, aws-us-gov, and future ones), regions, or account IDs. A reviewer rejected a partition allowlist as too strict and fragile.
SageMaker endpoint and other sagemaker ARNs must still return False, and so must a mismatched resource type like mlflow-tracking-server-other.
Add new cases to tests/utils/test_uri.py:test_is_sagemaker_mlflow_tracking_uri rather than tightening the check.
applies: Tracking-URI and ARN shape detection in mlflow/utils/uri.py.
says: Cannot connect to SageMaker tracking server located in AWS GovCloud or China regions.
Allow SageMaker tracking server resource identifiers from any cloud region or partition.
SageMaker tracking URI validation rejects tracking servers running in sovereign government clouds.
Entering a SageMaker endpoint address should not be accepted as a tracking server.
Support connecting tracking clients to SageMaker tracking servers in new AWS regions.
search: The SageMaker tracking URI detector in mlflow/utils/uri.py validates ARN structural shape rather than restricting AWS partition, region, or account ID. is_sagemaker_mlflow_tracking_uri verifies the ARN prefix, the sagemaker service, the exact mlflow-tracking-server resource type, and a non-empty resource ID. Partition allowlists covering aws, aws-cn, and aws-us-gov are rejected as fragile, but endpoint ARNs and mismatched resource types like mlflow-tracking-server-other must evaluate to False. New verification cases belong in tests/utils/test_uri.py:test_is_sagemaker_mlflow_tracking_uri instead of tightening detection logic.
